properties.name: A proof counts what it should: phase 1 of the primes-trial fixes
properties.rationale:
From fact:the-primes-trial-rung-1-ran-on-flo2-io-and-its-friction-names-what-counts-2026-10-17: the trial's friction was in what counts — a hand-set computed check held a premise, a lost premise read false, a refutation read as a defect, confirmation and citation were invisible to the loop, and software-shaped gaps fired on a proof. Choices made where the brief left one: (1) "computed" is the optional `computed` flag or a `.calc.json` location/record, because the schema has no computation method and adding one moves the stamp; (2) a record states the result through the PRODUCES outcome, else the check's findings, since the server never opens the file; (3) the refutation exemption applies only when one side takes part in an Inference, so an accepted Decision contradicting a proposed one stays a live question; (4) a reasoning design is decided from structure (an Inference, no Capability/Component/Flow, every live Requirement in the reasoning); (5) a reasoning single point of failure is the nearest lemma (never an axiom) every holding line rests on, checked by counting it lost; (6) the reasoning debt is said in loop_status `next` and, like loop_closure, not counted against `clean`; (7) describe_schema compacts only when the caller names a budget. Deferred: the Constraint direction default on a taken-as-given axiom, a host re-running a record, and phase 2 (proof skill, statement kinds, conjecture status, independent lines). Checks run locally: the full core suite, the full MCP in-memory suite, both clippy invocations with -D warnings, fmt, and 18 Python gates (schema, discrimination rules, skill_lint, render_skills_and_tools, vocabulary_reach, smoke, empty_speaks, refusal_speaks, toolsnap, titles, tool_confusability, replies_are_bounded, a_reply_is_sent_once, PII, command surface, phase_trial, model_the_loop, coherent_erosion_trial). PR #763.

properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Phase 1 of the six of eight requirements Anthony accepted after the primes trial, with no schema-stamp move: three optional properties only (Verification.computed, Requirement/Constraint.taken_as_given). A computed check holds an inference premise only through its kept record and otherwise reads asserted (unknown). A concluded node holds or is unsupported, never false from its steps, and the what-if says of each claim still_supported (still_supported_by), unsupported or refuted, with steps unsupported/weakened/broken. A standing refutation in a line of reasoning is not a contradiction defect (swept.suppressed_by_refutation). loop_status.reasoning and the unconfirmed_reasoning gap count unconfirmed steps, uncited premises and claims shown but not proven; taken_as_given marks a stated foundation. A reasoning design skips concept_without_design and quality_target_unstated; unlinked_intent counts PREMISE_OF/CONCLUDES; single points of failure are found in inference chains; a what-if never turns along a line of reasoning. Snags: gap prompts by id, describe_schema within a named budget, the verifies shape, a location-named record cited, the first instructions section under a cap.
